title: Go-time pocket scratchpad
content:
Quick pocket notes for today's go-time (personal scratchpad / last-minute checklist)

Context: finalizing v2.4 runtime roll (latency improvements + batching tweak). I'm on rotation as runner. Keep this terse: things to watch, who to ping, backports, and rollback triggers.

TIMELINE (local times)
- 09:00 — preflight call (15m): sanity checks, clear blockers, confirm monitoring dashboards up
- 09:20 — branch cut and announce in #deploys (emoji: :rocket:)
- 09:30 — canary push to dedicated-us-west-2-canary pool (10 nodes)
- 09:45 — 30m canary observation window (SLOs: p50 < 60ms; error rate < 0.1%)
- 10:15 — ramp to 30% (autoscale config change)
- 10:45 — full ramp if stable; otherwise abort and rollback to v2.3

PRE-FLIGHT QUICKS (checkbox-style reminders)
- [ ] Verify migrations: none in this build (good)
- [ ] Confirm healthcheck endpoint /health returns 200 within 500ms from monitoring rigs
- [ ] KV prefix cache warmers primed for top-50 prefixes (script: ops/warm_cache.sh)
- [ ] Confirm KMS key (projects/redwood/kms/serve) accessible from private-deploy agent
- [ ] Staging smoke ok? Last smoke: 2026-03-11 22:03 by @marco

ZERO-HOUR: RUNNER ACTIONS
- Announce start: "go-time v2.4 — canary -> 30% -> full. Runner: Sana R. Call if anomalies."
- Kick off canary deployment (CLI): ./bin/deploy --env=canary --tag=v2.4-canary --pool=us-west-2-canary
- Tail logs: kubectl -n inference logs -l app=serve -f --since=1m (watch for OOM / 502 spikes)
- Open dashboard: Console > models > v2.4-canary > trace -> set time range rolling 5m
- Confirm continuous-batching param set to 400ms (was the fix); double-check PR config lines 32-38 (PR#2894)

BACKPORT LIST (if hotfix needed)
- backport A: revert batching window change (PR: revert-batching-400ms) — hotfix branch: hotfix/revert-batching-2026-03-13
- backport B: pin kernel selector to fallback (kernel-v2-compat) — ticket RELENG-712
- note: prepare backport branch BEFORE full ramp to reduce blast radius

ROLLBACK TRIGGERS (immediate abort if any true)
- sustained p50 > 150ms for 3 consecutive 1-min buckets
- error rate > 0.5% for > 5m
- any Pod restarts > 10% within 10m window
- critical customer report (page from support) about malformed outputs

COMMUNICATION SNIPPETS (copy-paste)
- To #deploys at start: "Starting go-time v2.4 canary @ 09:30 — runner Sana R. Monitoring p50/p90 and errors closely. Ping me directly for urgent flags."
- To SRE on page: "Paging SRE on-call — canary seeing sustained 502 spikes, reverting to v2.3 unless acknowledged in 5m. Link: RELENG-712"

PERSONAL RUNNER NOTES / TO-DO (fast, messy)
- Phone on silent, watch laptop notifications only from Slack direct / pager
- Keep coffee close, carbs prepped (this takes ~40–90m depending on ramps)
- If anything weird, triage: logs -> request traces -> model traces -> config diff
- If rollback, comment PRs and leave breadcrumbs in #deploys with timing and cause

MONITORING CHECKS (first 10m of canary)
- Metrics to watch: p50 latency, p90, p99, error rate, pod restart counts, GPU mem utilization (per-node), queue length for batching
- Grafana panels: Serve > Latency (p50/p90/p99) | Errors > 5m | Pod Restarts | Kernel Selector OK | KV Cache hit rate
- SLO quick targets: p50<60ms, p90<180ms, error rate <0.1% (canary slack factors considered)

KNOWN RISK ITEMS (callouts)
- Edge-case: quantized paths may trigger memory fragmentation after extended runs (observed last week on canary-2)
- Heavily cached prefixes could bias batching -> watch per-prefix latency deltas

POST-GO: RETROSPECTIVE SWEEPS
- Collect sampling traces for any requests > p90 and archive under s3://releases/v2.4/traces/YYYYMMDD
- Capture canary-to-prod timing and notes in RELENG ticket
- Quick follow-up: ensure canary node that hit high GPU mem is cycled

UNRESOLVED QUESTIONS / TODO AFTER CALL
- Confirm if autoscale threshold 70% GPU should be reduced to 65% for v2 family (ask @priya)
- Add a quick eval prompt set to detect subtle output regressions (follow up w/ applied-ml)

LAST-MINUTE PERSONAL FLAGS
- If I need to step away for >5m, handover to Marco D. (he's on standby)
- Keep the doc live in my browser for timestamps — I'll paste a short timeline to RELENG ticket after full ramp

---
Scratchiness intentionally: use as timestamped living notes during the go window. If anything becomes formal, move to the RELENG ticket and close this scratchpad.
